studioNotice.title: Notice to studio customers
studioNotice.subtitle: Under s.4C of the Consumer Protection Law – draft for the lawyer's approval
studioNotice.body1: Every work in the studio is a unique original. Each price is shown next to the work or given on request, and includes {vat}.
studioNotice.body2: Studio purchases come with a receipt and a written summary of the transaction. Cancellation and returns for studio purchases: {policy}

studioNotice.body3: Distance purchases (on the website, by phone or WhatsApp) can be cancelled as described on the "Cancel a purchase" page:
